{{Quote|A trio of Rebel operatives were attempting to lure an Imperial general into a trap. As part of the lure, the operatives had to appear to be almost overcome by Imperial forces. Just as the general approached, Graf Yonna appeared and started blasting away, killing the general. Graf's only response was "I acted against evil."|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="CRO" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] fought a short '''campaign''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baes Logia]]. The [[Carosite]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Tamo Lan]] was part of the Alliance forces on the world.<ref name="AJ10" /> During the campaign, a group of [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service]] operatives tried to capture an Imperial [[General/Legends|general]], but the insane [[Graf Yonna]] attacked Imperial forces for no reason and the general was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="CRO" />
